name: Praise Dancing
overview: Scripture presents praise dancing as a heartfelt expression of worship and joy directed toward the Lord, exemplified by Miriam leading women with timbrels and dances after deliverance (Exodus 15:20) and Jephthah's daughter greeting her father with dance and music (Judges 11:34). The Psalms further affirm dancing as a response to God's transformative grace, turning mourning into gladness (Psalm 30:11), and as a means to praise God with various instruments and in joyful celebration (Psalms 149:3; 150:1,4). These passages collectively affirm that praise dancing is a biblically grounded, Spirit-led act of worship that honors God with gladness and reverence.
